column1: # NavSafe final sweep — the 18 benchmark table rows.
#                     or an ABSOLUTE path for the augmentation rows, which are not in the zoo)
# Row order follows the paper table: rule-based, IL, world-model, RLFT,
# augmentation. `pdm_closed` is privileged and takes no checkpoint.
# The four augmentation rows are NOT in model_zoo/ — their weights are
# third-party releases whose redistribution terms were never cleared, so they
# live under /avl-west/navsafe_eval/aug_zoo/ instead, fetched from upstream:
#   SimScale     HF dataset OpenDriveLab/SimScale (a DATASET repo, not a model repo)
#   BeyondDrive  Google Drive, via github.com/wjl2244/BeyondDrive's Model Zoo
#                (the `wjl2244/BeyondDrive` HF path in navsafe_eval.md does not exist)
# Both DiffusionDrive variants need kmeans_navsim_traj_20.npy BESIDE the
# checkpoint — the adapter resolves it from Path(checkpoint).resolve().parent.
